pictures.scene: Hans Memling, Virgin Enthroned with Child and Two Angels Making Music — the angels bent over their instruments beside the throne, sing to the LORD a new song, sing to the LORD all the earth
pictures.name: pd_memling_lied

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, St Peter Preaching in the Presence of St Mark — the apostle standing up over the listening crowd with his hand raised, sing to the LORD bless His name, proclaim His salvation day after day
pictures.name: pd_angelico_naam

pictures.scene: Titian, The Descent of the Holy Spirit — the flames coming down on the gathered disciples in the opened light, declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all peoples
pictures.name: pd_titiaan_wonderen

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, Mount Corcoran — the great peak standing up over the still lake and the dark pines, for great is the LORD and greatly to be praised, He is to be feared above all gods
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_groot

pictures.scene: Adriaen van Stalbemt, Paul and Barnabas at Lystra — the apostles tearing their clothes to stop the people sacrificing to them before the idol's temple, for all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens
pictures.name: pd_stalbemt_afgoden

pictures.scene: Giovanni Paolo Panini, Interior of Saint Peter's, Rome — the enormous nave opening away under its vaults and gold, splendor and majesty are before Him, strength and beauty fill His sanctuary
pictures.name: pd_panini_heiligdom

lines.text: Sing to the LORD a new song;
sing to the LORD, all the earth.
Sing to the LORD, bless His name;
proclaim His salvation day after day.
Declare His glory among the nations,
For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised;
He is to be feared above all gods.
For all the gods of the nations are idols,
but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
Splendor and majesty are before Him;
strength and beauty fill His sanctuary.
